subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the grouped action bump be accepted after direct Codex-source inspection and privileged workflow canaries, or should the credential-bearing updates be split from routine setup-action updates?
rationale: The patch changes upstream code executed with API keys, GitHub App private keys, registry credentials, and repository write permissions; CI syntax checks alone cannot establish the intended security boundary.

options.title: Canary then merge together
options.body: Rebase and manually verify the privileged workflows, then retain the grouped immutable-pin update if all canaries pass.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate Codex, token, Docker publishing, CodeQL upload, stale, and labeler changes so each credential-bearing action can be reviewed and rolled back independently.

recommendation.title: Canary then merge together
recommendation.body: Rebase and manually verify the privileged workflows, then retain the grouped immutable-pin update if all canaries pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history spans repository-wide action modernization, Codex-agent workflows, and Docker release automation touched by this PR.
